source_title: Liverpool news: Fan confident of beating champions Arsenal - BBC
source_excerpt:
Liverpool fan Nahyan Chowdhury is in confident mood ahead of Sunday's game against champions Arsenal at Anfield (16:30 GMT).
"It's a tough match against Arsenal no matter when you play them. They come to Anfield in the first time in 20 years as champions, so they're going to be full of confidence," he said.
"However, they did say that last year, I know a lot of Arsenal fans were so confident and then we won.
"Liverpool should be confident too. I think we're going under the radar, things are slowly starting to click. Bradley Barcola and Alexander Isak are linking up.
"Florian Wirtz is looking better and the back line is linking up. The majority of people will bet against us but I honestly think we'll have Arsenal."
You can listen to the full clip on BBC Sounds.
